info.title: LastShoot API
info.description:
**LastShoot** is an identity generation API for developers and product teams.

Generate, preserve, swap, and animate real people using open-source models.
All endpoints are independent primitives that compose freely into full content workflows.

---

### Authentication

Every request requires an `X-API-Key` header:

```
X-API-Key: <your_api_key>
```

Get your key from the [dashboard](https://www.lastshoot.com/dashboard).

---

### How jobs work

All compute endpoints are **asynchronous** — they return immediately with a `job_id`
and `status: queued`. Retrieve the result in one of two ways:

| Method | How |
|---|---|
| **Poll** | `GET /{endpoint}/status/{job_id}` until `status` is `completed` or `failed` |
| **Webhook** | Pass `callback_url` in the request body — we POST a `WebhookEvent` on completion |

Recommended: use webhooks for production, polling for development.

---

### Result URL lifecycle

> ⚠️ **Result URLs expire within 24 hours.**
>
> `result_url` is a temporary pre-signed download link.
> Download and store the file in your own storage immediately after the job completes.
> Do not persist the URL itself — it will stop working.

---

### Composable workflows

Every endpoint is an independent primitive. Chain them in any order:

| Workflow | Steps |
|---|---|
| **Identity** | Generate → Lock → Try-on → Animate |
| **Content** | Generate → Faceswap → Background → Upscale |
| **Brand** | Generate → Background → Branding → Upscale |

---

### Request format

All request bodies are **flat JSON** — no nested `payload` wrapper:

```json
{
  "prompt": "a person in a red jacket on a rooftop",
  "height": 1024,
  "width": 1024,
  "output_format": "webp",
  "callback_url": "https://yourserver.com/webhook"
}
```

---

### Compliance

All outputs include embedded **C2PA provenance metadata** satisfying
EU AI Act Article 50 (AI-generated content disclosure).
LastShoot processes media ephemerally — we are a data processor,
not a data controller. Your inputs and outputs are never stored long-term.
info.x-result-url-notice: Result URLs returned by this API are temporary pre-signed download links. They expire shortly after the job completes. Download and persist the file in your own storage before the TTL elapses.

post.description:
Create a named identity profile that stores an adapter config snapshot and an optional pointer to your own S3 bucket.

**Zero data retention:** LastShoot never stores face images. The S3 config is a pointer to *your* bucket — we never access it. Your encryption key is never sent to or stored by this API.

Once created, pass `profile_id` in any identity endpoint request (`/identity/lock`, `/identity/faceswap`, `/creator/tryon`, etc.) to apply this profile's config automatically.

get.description: Return all identity profiles for the authenticated user, newest first.
Fetch a single identity profile by ID.

patch.description: Partially update a profile. Only fields included in the request body are changed. Adapter config fields (prompt_template, steps, cfg_scale, etc.) are merged — omitted fields keep their existing values.

delete.description: Delete an identity profile. This removes the profile record and its adapter config snapshot. It does NOT delete anything from your S3 bucket — your reference images remain under your control.

post.description:
Replace image backgrounds intelligently

Seamlessly replaces backgrounds while perfectly preserving your main subject.
Maintains natural lighting, shadows, and edge details for professional-quality results.

**Plan-based routing:**
- PRO plan → Standard processing queue
- STUDIO plan → Priority processing queue
- Enterprise plans → Dedicated high-performance queues

**Features:**
- Intelligent background replacement
- Subject preservation
- Natural lighting and shadows
- Edge detail retention

Removes the background from an image using BiRefNet (best-in-class for hair and fine edges).

Always returns a transparent PNG cutout (`cutout_url`). When `recolor` is provided, also returns a flat-background composite (`result_url`). Set `drop_shadow: true` to add a soft drop shadow before compositing.

**Plan-based routing:**
- PRO plan → Standard processing queue
- STUDIO plan → Priority processing queue
- Enterprise plans → Dedicated high-performance queues

Stamp your company logo onto an image.

Downloads `input_image`, overlays `logo_url` at the chosen corner
(default: `bottom_right`) at a small pixel size and 50% opacity.
Pure image compositing — no GPU required, typically completes in 1–2 s.

**Plan-based routing:**
- PRO plan → Standard processing queue
- STUDIO plan → Priority processing queue
- Enterprise plans → Dedicated high-performance queues

Brand Scene Composer — derive a palette from your photo and generate a matching background.

Automatically extracts the dominant clothing/accessory colors from `input_image`,
transforms them by `palette_mode` (similar / complementary / radical), and uses
the result to drive a background swap via instruction-based image editing.

The generated `palette` (hex codes) is returned in the completed job status so you
can reuse it across other brand assets.

Optionally stamps your logo at a chosen corner after generation.

**Plan-based routing:**
- PRO plan → Standard processing queue
- STUDIO plan → Priority processing queue
- Enterprise plans → Dedicated high-performance queues

get.description:
Returns an example `WebhookEvent` payload — the exact JSON object we POST to your `callback_url` when a job completes or fails.

Use this endpoint to inspect the schema interactively. Refer to the `WebhookEvent` model in the Schemas section below for full field descriptions.

delete.summary: Request erasure of my account data (GDPR right to erasure)
delete.description: Schedules permanent erasure of the personal data held for **your own account** after a 30-day grace period. **API access is disabled immediately**, while the erasure itself happens at the end of the window — so you have 30 days to change your mind via `POST /v1/user/data/cancel`. After that it cannot be undone. Erased at the end of the window: your email, name, IP address, country and API key; all identity profiles (presets, prompt templates); the request content of every job, meaning prompts and input image URLs; and any dedicated GPU pod assignment. Retained: billing records (cost, duration, timestamps), which are required for accounting and are no longer linked to identifying information; and Stripe invoices and customer records, which Stripe holds as a separate controller and which are generally required for tax purposes. Generated images are not addressed here because the storage bucket deletes every output automatically after 24 hours. Pass your own `user_id` as `confirm` to show the request is intentional.

403.description: `confirm` did not match the authenticated account.

404.description: No data found for this account.

post.description: Cancels a pending erasure and restores API access and your previous plan. Only works while the grace period is still open — once the erasure has run it cannot be reversed. This endpoint stays reachable while an account is pending deletion, which is why it is the one call not blocked in that state.

404.description: No pending erasure request for this account.

prompt_template_mode.description: How to combine the profile's prompt_template with the caller's prompt. 'suffix' (default) appends the template after; 'prefix' prepends it before.

Frozen copy of the adapter config active when the profile was created or
last updated. Stored alongside the profile so jobs are reproducible even

input_image.title: Input Image
input_image.description: Public URL of the image whose background will be replaced.

prompt.title: Prompt
prompt.description: Describe the new background — e.g. `beach at sunset`, `white studio background`, `forest path in autumn`.

use_segmentation.title: Use Segmentation
use_segmentation.description: When `true` (default), the subject is isolated and composited back over the generated background — preserves subject edges cleanly. When `false`, the full image edit is used with colour correction.

tone_correction.title: Tone Correction
tone_correction.description: Colour correction strength (0.0–1.0). Blends the edited background's colour profile toward the original to reduce drift. Default: `0.6`.

subject_description.title: Subject Description
subject_description.description: Short description of the main subject to preserve — e.g. `protein powder tub`, `glass bottle`, `sneakers`, `person`. Helps the segmentation model identify exactly what to keep.

has_text.title: Has Text
has_text.description: Whether the image contains visible text or labels. Set to `false` to skip text detection and save ~2–3 s. Omit to auto-detect.

palette.title: Palette
palette.description: Brand colour palette as hex codes. Blended into the output.

num_inference_steps.title: Num Inference Steps
num_inference_steps.description: Number of diffusion steps. Default: `8`. Higher = more detail, slower.

harmonize_strength.title: Harmonize Strength
harmonize_strength.description: Lighting harmonization strength (0.0–1.0). When set, the subject's low-frequency lighting and colour cast are shifted to match the generated background (frequency-separated relight: high-frequency texture/labels stay from the original). `0.7` is a good starting point. Omit or `0` to disable (default).

callback_url.description: Webhook URL. When the job completes or fails we POST a `WebhookEvent` to this URL. `result_url` is temporary (~24 h) — download the file promptly.

tone_correction.description: Colour correction strength after editing (0.0–1.0). Corrects colour drift in the edited region toward the original image. Default: `0.6`. Set to `0.0` to disable.

num_inference_steps.title: Num Inference Steps
num_inference_steps.description: Number of diffusion steps (1–100). Higher = better quality but slower. Default: 8.

guidance_scale.title: Guidance Scale
guidance_scale.description: Classifier-free guidance scale (0.0–20.0). Set to 0 to disable CFG on distilled models. Default: 1.5.

callback_url.description: Optional webhook URL. When the job completes or fails we POST a `WebhookEvent` object to this URL. See the **WebhookEvent** schema (Webhooks section) for the exact payload shape. `result_url` in the payload is temporary (∼24 h) — download the file immediately.

profile_id.description: Identity profile ID from `/profiles/v1`. When provided, the profile's prompt_template, quality settings, and brand palette are applied automatically — keeping theme and brand context consistent across an editing chain.

refine_strength.title: Refine Strength
refine_strength.description: Refinement pass after editing (0.0–1.0). At 0.25–0.40, preserves composition from the edit step while improving skin photorealism and texture detail. Omit or set to 0 to skip the refinement pass.

faster_inference.title: Faster Inference
faster_inference.description: When `true` (default), uses a distilled model for fast 8-step inference. Set to `false` for higher-quality 20-step inference without distillation — slower but preserves finer product and skin details.

cfg_norm_strength.title: Cfg Norm Strength
cfg_norm_strength.description: CFG normalization strength (0.0–1.0). Rescales the guided prediction to match the magnitude of the conditioned-only prediction, preventing colour saturation and tone shifts caused by high `true_cfg_scale`. Try 0.5–0.8 when colours look oversaturated. 0 (default) disables it.

product_saturation.title: Product Saturation
product_saturation.description: Saturation multiplier applied to the product image (image 2) before editing. 0.0 = greyscale, 1.0 = unchanged, <1.0 desaturates (e.g. 0.85 reduces colour shift). Omit to use the server default (0.85).

tone_correction.title: Tone Correction
tone_correction.description: Post-edit tonal correction strength (0.0–1.0). Corrects colour drift that diffusion models introduce in edited regions — blends the colour profile of the edited area toward the original image. `0.0` disables it, `1.0` is full correction. Default: `0.6`. Lower values (`0.3–0.5`) preserve more of the model's generated colour.

has_text.title: Has Text
has_text.description: Whether the image contains visible text, logos, or labels. When `false`, text detection (EasyOCR) is skipped — saves ~2–3 s if your image has no text. When `true` or omitted, text regions are auto-detected and preserved during background changes. Only applies to `bg_change` edits.

has_product.title: Has Product
has_product.description: Whether the image contains a physical product as the main subject. Passed to the worker for routing and analytics. Does not affect mask logic.

failure_reason_code.description:
Stable machine-readable failure code. Use for programmatic error handling.

| Code | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `RATE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED` | Too many requests — back off and retry |
| `CONCURRENT_JOBS_EXCEEDED` | Too many parallel jobs for your plan |
| `INSUFFICIENT_BALANCE` | Account balance is $0 and no overage method on file |
| `BILLING_FAILED` | Balance could not be deducted — contact support |
| `INPUT_INVALID` | Malformed URL, unreachable image, or invalid parameters |
| `MODEL_ERROR` | Inference pipeline error — retry or contact support |
| `STORAGE_ERROR` | Output could not be stored — retry |
| `TIMEOUT` | Job exceeded max processing time — retry |
| `MODEL_UNAVAILABLE` | Model temporarily offline — retry in a few minutes |
| `INTERNAL_ERROR` | Unexpected server error — contact support if persistent |
| `CANCELLED` | Job was cancelled |

WebhookEvent.title: WebhookEvent
WebhookEvent.description:
JSON object POSTed to your ``callback_url`` when a job completes or fails.

Delivery behaviour
------------------
* We attempt delivery up to **3 times** with exponential back-off (1 s, 2 s).
* Your endpoint must return **HTTP 2xx within 10 seconds** to be considered
  successful; any other response (or a timeout) triggers a retry.
* No delivery guarantee after all retries are exhausted.

.. warning::
   ``result_url`` is a **temporary URL** that expires within **24 hours**
   of generation.  Download and persist the file immediately upon receiving
   this event — do not store the URL itself.

input.prompt: Beautiful woman in dynamic pose, studio lighting

tags.name: Identity
tags.description:
Core identity primitives: face swap, identity lock, identity replace, virtual try-on, voice cloning, and AI model generation.

All outputs embed C2PA provenance metadata (EU AI Act Art. 50 compliant).

**Typical flows:**
- `Generate → Lock → Try-on → Animate`
- `Faceswap → Background → Upscale`

tags.name: Generate
tags.description:
Text-to-image, image-to-video, text-to-speech, and image-to-3D generation.

Use standalone or as the first step in an identity or branding workflow.

**Typical flow:** `Generate → Identity Lock → Background → Upscale`

tags.name: Edit
tags.description:
Instruction-based image editing via natural language prompts.

Change scenes, swap objects, adjust lighting, or recompose an image without writing a single line of image processing code.

Supports a `mode` parameter for specialised editing — `anime` converts a photo to an illustrated style.

Pairs well with Identity endpoints: generate or lock an identity, then use Edit to place them in a new scene.

tags.name: Background
tags.description:
Background replacement and relighting. Works on any image — generated or uploaded.

Preserves the subject with natural lighting, shadows, and edge detail.

**Typical use:** Clean up an identity-generated image before adding branding or publishing.

tags.name: Branding
tags.description:
Logo generation and branded template creation.

Inject brand colours, style rules, and logo overlays into generated assets.

Designed to sit at the **end** of content workflows: `Identity → Background → Branding → Upscale`.

tags.name: Upscale
tags.description:
Resolution upscaling and detail enhancement.

Use as the **final step** in any workflow before delivery. Outputs are suitable for print and high-resolution display.

tags.name: Webhooks
tags.description:
Webhook delivery reference.

Pass `callback_url` in any request body to receive a `WebhookEvent` POST when the job completes or fails.

**Delivery behaviour:**
- Up to **3 attempts** with exponential back-off (1 s, 2 s)
- Your endpoint must return **HTTP 2xx within 10 seconds**
- No delivery guarantee after all retries are exhausted

> ⚠️ **`result_url` is temporary.** Pre-signed links expire within 24 hours. Download and store the output immediately upon receiving the webhook.
